problem: The sentence giving the sign of the derivative is broken: 'The derivative is positive when RL th and negative when RL > Rth'. The first inequality has lost its '< Rth' part (the '<' has been swallowed as markup), so the condition is unreadable and a student cannot follow the max/min argument.
fix: The derivative is positive when R<sub>L</sub> < R<sub>th</sub> and negative when R<sub>L</sub> > R<sub>th</sub>, so the point is a maximum.
